correctness.rationale: The three-state Markov coding A=(0,1/2), B=(1/2,2/3), C=(2/3,1) has marked transitions A→A,B,C; B→C; C→A,B. Its matrix M(z) has characteristic polynomial t(t²−t−2z). The exact trace polynomial has coefficients m/(m−j)*binom(m−j,j)*2^j. Subtract the all-A fixed point and the two alternating B/C boundary encodings at even m (one fixed point 2/3 counted twice). The remaining weighted point counts are E_{m,j}; Möbius inversion by repeated orbit counts and division by n gives every primitive cycle N_{n,k}. Direct independent symbolic traces for n=2..8 agree with coefficients, while the inspected exact rational checker covers 2..12 by another method. The Perron eigenvalue (1+sqrt(1+8e^t))/2 has log-derivatives 1/3 and 2/27. Primitive periods differing from full-period traces contribute exponentially less, giving a valid MGF Gaussian limit. Bhattacharya Cor.4.11 is genuinely applicable to unimodal patterns, as read in its full proof. No claim concerns other maps or local CLT.

The exact marked boundary correction and Möbius spectrum remain best-of-knowledge new.
